fields.title: 5. Corrections and Resolutions from the Previous Edition
fields.md:
- **1 resolved**: "Primary filing for the $40 billion financing" — the 8-K of 10/26 confirmed the structure, size, maturity, rent formula and schedule. The interest rate remains unresolved (awaiting the 8-K on execution) (source: Section 1).
- **2 press correction records**: Bloomberg's 10/23 'private bond, 3 tranches' and 'off-balance-sheet SPV' differ from the filing's 'lease schedule tranches' and 'finance lease' — the press reports are not deleted; the filing takes precedence and overrides them (Rule 1: where sources differ, record both and adopt the one closer to ①) (source: Section 1).
- **Unresolved, kept open**: original source of "5-year CDS 197.6bp" · Gokhshtein's "$8.3 billion price confirmed" (not adopted) (source: Section 5 of the previous edition).
